title: MEOK Pinned Process Replay
subtitle: Pinned synthetic checkpoints and data for offline CPU result reproduction
description:
# MEOK pinned process replay

Public synthetic research inputs from csoai/meok-oowm-hybrid-lab at `1c2395b61d8d45955b28f05f971e759ddc799b49`. Six small checkpoint variants, 560 original and 640 later same-generator evaluation transitions, and their retained reference metrics.

MIT licensing and original model/data notices are retained in the accompanying files. Kaggle metadata uses Other (specified in description) only if the platform does not expose MIT; no CC0 or relicensing is claimed.

The supplied manifest maps logical source paths to flat Kaggle filenames and SHA-256 digests. The separately authored standard-library Python notebook pins the manifest digest `9ad0d91f9f6a80e89252c897b20dc689b4e6cba0a73babc0a5967c41289b58b2` before reading data. No credentials, internet access, GPU, model-provider API or package installation is needed during replay.

These are already public synthetic banks, not customer data, human evidence, a fresh blind benchmark or a GSPC-admitted result. The fitted head and worst-case failures stay as published; no training or promotion occurs.

Original source ownership: https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/councilof-ai/pull/4176 .
